text: ブルー　バッジが　あれば　レベル３０までの　ポケモンは　おとなしく　いうこと　きくわ！

structure.jp: ブルー　バッジが　あれば
structure.en: if you have the Cascade Badge

structure.jp: レベル３０までの　ポケモンは
おとなしく　いうこと　きくわ！
structure.en: will obediently do what you say!

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending means 'if'. ブルー　バッジが　あれば = 'if you have the Cascade Badge'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a feminine way of stating something with a little feeling. It adds no meaning of its own. いうこと　きくわ = 'they'll do what you say!'.
